author: Skeletonicki013
body:
The RETURN OF /stats!

/stats was a useful command I used in the old days of Avicus, and as far as McZone. As far as I know, I really liked the command but now feel sad for it being removed. But why not bring it back? It can be put with different features that we can use today. Here is the list of features that I believe should be implemented to the NEW /stats command.

/stats:

Kills: This is the total game kills the player received in a game, until you log out from that particular server.
Deaths: This is the total amount of game deaths the player received in a game, until you log out from the particular server.
Kill/Death Ratio: This is where the player know the average amount of kills you have in that particular server K/D-R

Credits Earned: This is where the player will know how much credits you have earned being in that server.
Credits Total: The total amount of credits the player has to that time.

Time played: Total amount of time being in that server.

This is what I had in mind when I wrote this. I will add more different features if I can get the thought of it.

-Skeletonicki013

P.S. - Pls add!! I STILL <3 U AVICUS!!!
P.S.S. - If you have any more ideas to the /stats suggestion, then please comment this thread! TY!
